Description.SourceString: Face Lord Ashbourne in his castle.
Description.LocalizedString: Face Lord Ashbourne in his castle.

CompletionText.SourceString: With Lord Ashbourne defeated, a wave of relief and triumph swept through me. The oppressive weight of his tyranny had finally been lifted from the people of Karvenia, allowing them to breathe freely for the first time in years. As night fell, I knew that this victory was just the beginning; a new chapter awaited us, filled with hope and the promise of rebuilding our lives.
